/bin/zsh -lc "./nipa query library.files '{\"limit\": 100, \"select\": [\"fileId\",\"locator\"]}' > records/files.json 2>&1
python3 -c '
import json,re
files=json.load(open(\"records/files.json\"))[\"result\"][\"rows\"]
eps=json.load(open(\"records/bangumi-285493-episodes.json\"))[\"data\"][\"data\"]
epmap={e[\"sort\"]:e[\"id\"] for e in eps}
entries=[]
for f in files:
    m=re.search(r\"S01E(\\d+)\", f[\"locator\"])
    n=int(m.group(1))
    entries.append({\"kind\":\"file\",\"entityId\":f[\"fileId\"],
      \"workRef\":{\"provider\":\"bangumi\",\"objectType\":\"subject\",\"externalId\":\"285493\",\"scope\":\"\"},
      \"episodeRefs\":[{\"provider\":\"bangumi\",\"objectType\":\"episode\",\"externalId\":str(epmap[n]),\"scope\":\"subject/285493\"}],
      \"reason\":\"文件名 S01E%02d 与 Bangumi 第 %d 集对应\"%(n,n)})
json.dump({\"requestId\":\"changan-file-bind-1\",\"entries\":entries}, open(\"records/bind-changan-files.json\",\"w\"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
print(\"entries\", len(entries))
'
./nipa call media.identity.bind_batch @records/bind-changan-files.json 2>&1 | python3 -c \"
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print(d.get('status'))
if d.get('status')"'!='"'completed': print(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False)[:800]); raise SystemExit
r=d['result']
print('entries', len(r['entries']))
print(json.dumps(r['entries'][0], ensure_ascii=False))
\""

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c '
import subprocess, os, re
ROOT=\"/Volumes/Anime/长安十二时辰/长安十二时辰.The.Longest.Day.In.Chang\\u0027an.2019.S01.2160p.IQ.WEB-DL.HEVC.AAC-ZmWeb\"
files={int(re.search(r\"S01E(\\d+)\",f).group(1)):f for f in os.listdir(ROOT) if f.endswith(\".mp4\")}
targets=[1,19,23,26,34,46]
def yavg(p):
    r=subprocess.run([\"ffprobe\",\"-v\",\"error\",\"-f\",\"lavfi\",\"-i\",\"movie=\"+p+\",signalstats\",\"-show_entries\",\"frame_tags=lavfi.signalstats.YAVG\",\"-of\",\"csv=p=0\"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    try: return float(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[0].split(\",\")[-1])
    except Exception: return -1
for n in targets:
    p=os.path.join(ROOT,files[n])
    d=float(subprocess.run([\"ffprobe\",\"-v\",\"error\",\"-show_entries\",\"format=duration\",\"-of\",\"csv=p=0\",p],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip())
    best=None
    for frac in [0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2,0.3,0.35,0.45,0.55,0.65,0.75,0.85]:
        t=max(20.0,d*frac)
        out=\"records/stills/_cand.jpg\"
        subprocess.run([\"ffmpeg\",\"-y\",\"-v\",\"error\",\"-ss\",str(t),\"-i\",p,\"-frames:v\",\"1\",\"-vf\",\"scale=640:-2\",\"-q:v\",\"3\",out],capture_output=True,text=True)
        y=yavg(out)
        if best is None or y>best[0]: best=(y,t,frac)
    print(n, \"best YAVG=%.1f t=%.0f frac=%.2f\"%(best[0],best[1],best[2]), flush=True)
'"
